item.description: For decades, ECU Mount Lawley has been a place of rehearsals, shaded courtyard catch-ups and creative chaos… Now, with ECU relocating to the city, the future of the 18.6-hectare Mount Lawley campus has officially been mapped out. item.title: Freo’s huge (and free) street theatre festival returns this Easter long weekend
item.description: Australia’s largest street arts festival is about to land back in Freo for a long weekend of death-defying acrobatics and whimsical theatre performances. Fremantle International Street Arts Festival (FISAF) will return this Easter long weekend (April 3-6) for its 26th year, with a chock-a-block program of over 160 free, family-friendly performances amongst Freo’s historic streets,…

item.title: Good Sammy unveils $5.7m Canning Vale transformation, expands inclusive employment
item.description: There’s a new chapter underway at Good Sammy’s Canning Vale headquarters. The WA social enterprise has officially opened its redeveloped head office and training centre, a $5.7 million transformation designed to expand inclusive employment and training opportunities for Western Australians with disability. item.description: During its 40 years of operation, the East Perth Watch House hosted some of Western Australia’s most notorious detainees. Article and photos by Brett Leigh Dicks. item.description: Starting this weekend, a world-renowned street artist Bordalo II will be in town – installing one of his iconic Big Trash Animals at the Fremantle Piazza. item.description: A project aimed at rewilding the City of Fremantle’s urban spaces is now underway, set to make William Street cooler, greener and more pedestrian-friendly. item.description: For more than a century, the WACA Ground has been where sporting legends were made – sun-baked days, lightning-fast pitches and some of the most memorable moments in Australian cricket history.
